acceptances.commentBody:
/sdlc accept sha256:b5bbac8a0776c782f279a9857cce1d4db37849c3b23a75bfe0797d184a54e16e

AUTHORIZED SCRIPTED DEVELOPMENT TEST. This decision is executed by the assistant using the explicitly authorized local huangyingting account. It is NOT independent Human acceptance and MUST NOT count toward Demo Ready. Preserve the durable development-test mode.

Observed against the actual published image:
`ghcr.io/huangyingting/ai-native-sdlc-demo-it-service-desk@sha256:b5bbac8a0776c782f279a9857cce1d4db37849c3b23a75bfe0797d184a54e16e`

Delivery: implementation PR #11; merge `0ef94e0deb685136102ca8ac5351d53e565e2efc`; publish/verify run https://github.com/huangyingting/ai-native-sdlc-demo/actions/runs/36286787715, attempt 2, all jobs successful. The delivered digest was actually pulled and run locally on an isolated labeled container and volume at port 43127.

Observed acceptance results:
- Fresh image health/dashboard checks and read-only database probes verified all four original seed rows, fields and exact timestamps. All initially displayed Unassigned; summary was 2 open, 1 in progress, 1 resolved, 2 active high/critical.
- AC-1: actual application tests exercised a persisted OLD-schema SQLite fixture and compared complete original records/timestamps after additive, idempotent migration. Fresh-image smoke is explicitly NOT the migration evidence.
- AC-2: actual keyboard-driven UI assignment of INC-0001 to Avery Stone, reassignment to Jordan Lee, clearing to Unassigned, with detail/dashboard reloads after each operation. Then assigned Avery again and restarted the SAME container with its existing volume. UI and a read-only probe confirmed the owner and exact updated_at survived unchanged. No cleanup occurred between persistence observations.
- AC-3: on that four-ticket dataset, exact sets were All={0001,0002,0003,0004}, Avery={0001,0003}, Jordan={0002}, Unassigned={0004}. Avery+open+high+inc-1 returned only INC-0001; Avery+critical returned no tickets. Selecting All owners preserved exact raw search text "  inc-1  ", open status and high priority without changing ticket ownership. A separately discovered same-root navigation/select-state bug was corrected and re-tested in an actual browser and a regression test before merge.
- AC-4: labeled owner and filter controls were operated using the keyboard. Real storage/server tests verified forged not-in-roster owners and nonexistent ticket IDs cannot mutate stored rows. No separate forged HTTP request against the production container is claimed.
- AC-5: explicitly reset ONLY the managed development container/volume, then ran the SAME digest on a fresh separate dataset. Created Ownership demo request / Verify a new unassigned ticket. / Other / low / Demo Requester / demo.requester@example.com. The creation form had no owner field. UI and read-only SQL verified every field plus initial open/null-owner defaults. Existing status update changed it to in_progress, preserved Unassigned after reload, and combined search Ownership demo + in_progress + low + unassigned returned exactly INC-0005. This fifth record was not included in AC-3.

Engineering/process evidence:
- Approved Spec v2 and Plan v3 were sealed. A real Spec revision invalidated earlier Spec approval and Plan v1; stale v1 approval was explicitly rejected. Open Plan questions were resolved through a real v3 revision before approval.
- Tests PR #10 proved controlled Red: 11 exact assertion-level failures, 27 passes, zero skipped/pending; trusted Red validation, lint and build passed.
- Final implementation had 41 passing application tests, lint and production build. Final-head immutable artifact/Green Stage CI: https://github.com/huangyingting/ai-native-sdlc-demo/actions/runs/36286576173 . Application CI including actual container smoke: https://github.com/huangyingting/ai-native-sdlc-demo/actions/runs/36286576185 . Approved document and test blobs stayed unchanged.
- Pause blocked new work and auto-merge; resume restored orchestration. Real failed document generation validation and workflow authorization problems were diagnosed and retried without bypassing gates. Native single-owner settings and all required custom policies/checks remained enforced.
- Maintenance PR #12 separately fixed current Docker missing-volume response handling and synthetic baseline test isolation, and documented observed operational recovery. It passed real checks and merged without changing the published application digest.

No remaining blocking issue was observed for this authorized development rehearsal. Limitations: scripted single-account decisions are not independent Human review; this is one development-test run, not three genuine live rehearsals; production credential hardening and independent Human acceptance remain future work. Original source main protection, unrelated local services and unrelated data were not changed by this rehearsal.
